records.name: Ambush
records.summary: Hold the Greymane camp through a night raid by the Black Bears.

steps.text: Stand with the Greymanes as the Black Bears hit the camp.
Cut down the raiders, including the Black Bear Elite among them.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Unfamiliar Lands
records.summary: Fall back to a cabin and hear from the Greymanes who made it out.

steps.text: Leave the fighting at the camp and make for the cabin marked for the survivors.
Talk with the Greymanes who reached it and hear how they mean to go on.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: In Ashes
records.summary: Cut down the Black Bears still in the camp and pull surviving Greymanes out of the fight.

steps.text: Return to the camp and engage the Black Bears who stayed behind.
Get the remaining Greymanes clear of the raid.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Unknown Space
records.summary: Wake in the Corridor of the Void and find a way through that Abyss passage.

steps.text: Get your bearings after waking in the Corridor of the Void.
Pick a path through the passage and keep moving until the next stretch opens.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Realm of Uncertainty
records.summary: Push on through the void, fire Blinding Flash at a light device, and reach the exit.

steps.text: Keep advancing through the Corridor of the Void.
Use Blinding Flash on the light device that blocks the way.
Find the exit and leave the passage.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: New Journey
records.summary: Walk out with Sebastian and make for Hernand to start the road ahead.

steps.text: Fall in behind Sebastian after the Abyss passage.
Travel with him toward Hernand and the city tavern that opens there.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Trials of Kindness
records.summary: Settle into Hernand Tavern by lending a hand to townsfolk and testing yourself at the arm-wrestling table.

steps.text: Enter Hernand Tavern and see who needs help on the floor.
Lend a hand to the villagers who ask, then take a turn at arm wrestling.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Where Rumors Gather
records.summary: Work the tavern floor, pick up local talk, and take a turn at arm wrestling.

steps.text: Look around Hernand Tavern and listen to what people are saying.
Sit down for arm wrestling once the floor has been checked.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Mysterious Man
records.summary: Offer a coin to the Old Beggar who waits near the tavern.

steps.text: Find the Old Beggar near Hernand Tavern.
Give him a coin and hear what he has to say.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: True Wisdom in Kindness
records.summary: Drop into Hernand's sewer and see what the tunnels are hiding.

steps.text: Find a way down into the city sewer.
Search the tunnels and finish whatever the errand asks below the streets.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Actions Speak Louder Than Words
records.summary: Seek out distressed people in the city and settle their trouble in person.

steps.text: Walk Hernand and find the villagers who are in distress.
Step in and deal with what is troubling them.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Hearts Beyond Borders
records.summary: Talk with a child in Hernand and take a missing cat back to its owner.

prerequisites.text: Complete Actions Speak Louder Than Words

steps.text: Speak with the child who is waiting in the city.
Find the cat and return it to its owner.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Trace
records.summary: Follow the trail of an engraved key into the Axiom Archive.

steps.text: Take up the engraved key and start following the trail it marks.
Carry that trail into the Axiom Archive in the Abyss.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Mystical Key
records.summary: Study the engraved key and open the room it marks inside Hernand Castle.

steps.text: Examine the engraved key and read what it is pointing at.
Go into Hernand Castle and open the room the key fits.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Polar Opposites
records.summary: Bring the Abyss Nexus to life and locate a way into the layer beyond.

steps.text: Activate the Abyss Nexus.
Find the entrance that opens once the Nexus is live.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Abyss Without Balance
records.summary: Cross a skybridge in the Abyss, join an Abyss Cell, and claim the artifact waiting there.

steps.text: Cross the skybridge in the Axiom Archive.
Combine the Abyss Cell.
Take the artifact on the far side.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Woman in White
records.summary: Speak with the Woman in White in the Abyss, then return to Hernand.

steps.text: Find the Woman in White and hear her out.
Leave the Abyss and return to Hernand.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Unexpected Gift
records.summary: Meet Shai and her cat Jiji and take the errand that starts this chapter.

steps.text: Find Shai; her cat Jiji is with her.
Hear her out and accept the work she offers.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Where the Light Leads
records.summary: Drive the bandits off Lioncrest Watchtower and inspect the helm they left.

steps.text: Travel to Lioncrest Watchtower.
Defeat the bandits holding the tower.
Examine the helm left on the site.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Memory Fragment
records.summary: Use the helm's stored memories to see what it recorded.

steps.text: Turn the Visione on the helm taken at Lioncrest Watchtower.
Watch the memories stored in it and note what they show.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Reunion
records.summary: Speak with a child and learn Nature's Grasp and Focus.

steps.text: Find the child and hear what they have to say.
Learn Nature's Grasp and Focus from that meeting.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Hernand in Chaos
records.summary: Face the unrest that has taken hold of Hernand and the jobs that come with it.
records.body: No source gives this arc header its own objective; the steps follow the Chapter 2 jobs that sit under it.

steps.text: Return to the City of Hernand as the streets go to pieces.
Take the first of the jobs the unrest throws up.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: For Honor
records.summary: Meet Matthias in a fight and beat him.

steps.text: Find Matthias in Hernand.
Defeat him.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Awestruck
records.summary: Find Barden Middler and hear what he has to say.

steps.text: Seek out Barden Middler in Hernand.
Speak with him and take the next instruction.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Shadow Cast Over the River
records.summary: Clear the enemies camped at Springtide Mill.

steps.text: Travel to Springtide Mill.
Defeat the enemies holding the mill.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Where Misery Gathers
records.summary: Work through the requests posted on the notice board.

prerequisites.text: Complete Shadow Cast Over the River

steps.text: Read the requests on the notice board in Hernand.
Finish those board jobs and report them done.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Trial After Trial
records.summary: Hit the bandit camp and break their hold on it.

steps.text: Travel to the bandit camp marked for this job.
Defeat the bandits there.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: The Man Trapped in the Mire
records.summary: Track a thief, confront him, and put him down.

steps.text: Track the thief to the ground he is using.
Confront him and defeat him.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Missing Companion
records.summary: Search the area until you find the missing sheep Wooly.

prerequisites.text: Complete The Man Trapped in the Mire

steps.text: Ask after Wooly and start searching the ground he wandered from.
Find the sheep and bring the search to a close.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Secrets Hidden in the Dark
records.summary: Enter the cave and stay with Boris as he leads the way.

steps.text: Meet Boris and enter the cave he is bound for.
Follow him through the dark and finish the search inside.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: The End of Greed
records.summary: Go to Serkis Estate and take up the Goldleaf thread that ends this chapter.

prerequisites.text: Complete Secrets Hidden in the Dark

steps.text: Travel to Serkis Estate.
Take the lead that points at the Goldleaf Merchant Guild.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: The Dark Veil
records.summary: Look into the Goldleaf Merchant Guild and what it is hiding.

steps.text: Go to the Goldleaf Merchant Guild.
Search the guild and camp for what the merchants are keeping from view.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: The Flames of Greed
records.summary: Pull a man out of the healer's house before the fire takes him.

steps.text: Reach the healer's house while it is still in danger.
Get the trapped man out.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Kidnapped Healer
records.summary: Find the taken healer and get that person out.

steps.text: Track the kidnapped healer from the house that was hit.
Free the healer and leave with them.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Rebellion of Revolution
records.summary: Speak with Shakatu and hear the Goldleaf side of the revolt.

steps.text: Find Shakatu after the Goldleaf investigation.
Speak with him; he becomes a trade ally from this meeting.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Cheers Echoing From the Edge
records.summary: Fight Kailok the Hornsplitter and finish the Golden Greed arc.

steps.text: Move to the ground where Hornsplitter is waiting.
Defeat Kailok the Hornsplitter.

rewards.text: Sword of the Lord (with Abyss Gears)

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Homestead
records.summary: Leave the City of Hernand and start raising a new Greymane camp on Howling Hill.

steps.text: Return to the City of Hernand after the Goldleaf affair.
Begin the work of putting a Greymane camp back together on Howling Hill.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Old Friend
records.summary: Search the back alleys of Hernand for a lead on someone from the old days.

steps.text: Leave the main streets of Hernand and enter the back alleys.
Search those lanes for the old friend the job is pointing at.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: First Step to Rebuilding
records.summary: Hear Marquis Serkis, then take the rebuilding brief on to Marshal Middler.

steps.text: Speak with Marquis Serkis about putting the Greymane camp back on its feet.
Carry that word to Marshal Middler and hear how the work should start.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: A Fresh Start
records.summary: Haul sacks, drive stakes, and raise a banner so the new camp has a shape.

steps.text: Move the sacks stacked for the new camp on Howling Hill.
Drive the stakes that mark the camp's ground.
Raise a banner over the site.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Reward for Their Sweat
records.summary: Cook a meal at the new camp and serve it as a feast for the workers.

steps.text: Cook the recipe marked for the camp feast.
Serve that meal to the people who have been raising the site.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Return of the Comrade
records.summary: Find Marius and walk him back to the Greymane camp on Howling Hill.

steps.text: Seek out Marius away from the hill.
Escort him to the camp on Howling Hill.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Familiar Curses
records.summary: Look through the House of Healing and stay with Yann as the trail unfolds.

steps.text: Go to the House of Healing and search it.
Follow Yann from there and finish the look-through.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: The Face Behind the Mask
records.summary: Go to Serkis Estate and take up the hunt that leads toward the Devil of the Reed Field.
records.body: No source gives this arc header its own objective; the steps are inferred from the Chapter 3 mask-and-devil jobs that sit under it.

steps.text: Travel to Serkis Estate.
Take the lead that points at the mask and the thing wearing it.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Return
records.summary: Find Marius and hear what he has to say after the camp work.

prerequisites.text: Complete The Face Behind the Mask

steps.text: Seek out Marius.
Speak with him and take the next instruction.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Traces in the Manor
records.summary: Search Glenbright Manor for whatever the mask hunt left behind.

steps.text: Travel to Glenbright Manor.
Search the rooms and grounds for traces of the hunt.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Nonhuman
records.summary: Follow the Devil of the Reed Field from the manor trail to Reedfield Graves.

steps.text: Pick up the Devil of the Reed Field's trail after Glenbright Manor.
Track that trail as far as Reedfield Graves.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Seed of Unease
records.summary: Study the altar and the doll left at Reedfield Graves.

steps.text: Examine the altar at Reedfield Graves.
Examine the doll left with it.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Dance with the Devil
records.summary: Fight the Devil of the Reed Field at the graves and put it down.

steps.text: Stand ready at Reedfield Graves for the Devil of the Reed Field.
Defeat the Devil of the Reed Field.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Pioneering
records.summary: Return to Serkis Estate and take up the jobs that grow Howling Hill.
records.body: No source gives this arc header its own objective; the steps are inferred from the Chapter 3 pioneering jobs that sit under it.

steps.text: Travel back to Serkis Estate.
Take the next stretch of work that builds out Howling Hill.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Hope After the Draught
records.summary: Look in on Andrew and see how he is holding up after the draught.

steps.text: Find Andrew.
Check his condition and hear how he is.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Scattered Comrades
records.summary: Speak with Marius about the Greymanes still spread across Hernand.

steps.text: Find Marius again.
Speak with him about the comrades still off the hill.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Rumors from the Sawmill
records.summary: Chase down the rumor coming out of the sawmill and see what it is worth.

steps.text: Go where the sawmill rumor is being told.
Look into the rumor and settle what it amounts to.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: A Gentle Touch
records.summary: Study the Dragon Head Totem at a shrine and read the letter left with it.

steps.text: Find the shrine that holds the Dragon Head Totem and examine it.
Read the letter waiting there.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Bustling Hill
records.summary: Push Howling Hill through its first camp expansion.

steps.text: Return to Howling Hill.
Carry out the work that expands the camp.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Greymanes Reunited
records.summary: Go back to the comrades at Howling Hill and close the chapter that rebuilt the camp.

steps.text: Return to the camp on Howling Hill.
Meet the Greymanes gathered there and finish the reunion.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Mysterious Iron Pot
records.summary: Go to Kilnden Workshop and find out what blew up there.

steps.text: Travel to Kilnden Workshop.
Look into the explosion on the grounds.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Kilnden Workshop
records.summary: Bring the Ancient Generator online and get the kilns at Kilnden Workshop running again.

steps.text: Activate the Ancient Generator at Kilnden Workshop.
Repair the kilns on the site.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Kiln Repair at the Kilnden Workshop
records.summary: Feed the kiln at Kilnden Workshop so the repair can hold.

steps.text: Return to the kiln at Kilnden Workshop.
Add fuel to the kiln.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: The Mysterious Pot
records.summary: Speak with Grimnir at the workshop and take the iron pot from him.

prerequisites.text: Complete Kiln Repair at the Kilnden Workshop

steps.text: Find Grimnir at Kilnden Workshop.
Speak with him and obtain the pot.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: The Iron Pot's Usage
records.summary: Learn how the iron pot is used; it is the Kuku Pot needed in the Abyss.

steps.text: Study the iron pot taken from Grimnir.
Learn the use that turns it into the Kuku Pot.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Daily Life
records.summary: Return to Howling Hill and take the camp-life jobs waiting there.
records.body: No source gives this arc header its own objective; the steps are inferred from the Chapter 4 camp-life jobs that sit under it.

steps.text: Travel back to Howling Hill.
Take the first of the camp-life jobs posted on the hill.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Disturbance at the Arena
records.summary: Step into the arena and win three matches.

steps.text: Go to the arena from Howling Hill.
Win three arena matches.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Skilled in Archery
records.summary: Take Duane's archery contest and win it.

steps.text: Find Duane and hear the rules of the contest.
Win the archery contest.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Forbidden Knowledge
records.summary: Read the letter that names Scholastone and start the road to the institute.

steps.text: Read the letter that opens this arc.
Set out for Scholastone.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: The Words of Alustin
records.summary: Read Alustin's letter, then visit the Fence named in it.

steps.text: Read Alustin's letter.
Visit the Fence the letter points to.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Scholastone
records.summary: Find the path to the Scholastone Institute and meet the Dean there.

steps.text: Find the path that leads to the Scholastone Institute.
Meet the Dean of the Scholastone Institute.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: On the Right Path
records.summary: Help Octavius with an experiment at Scholastone and take the artifact it yields.

steps.text: Join Octavius and help with the experiment.
Obtain the artifact that comes out of that work.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Gate to the Otherworld
records.summary: Climb the Spire of the Stars until you stand at the top.

steps.text: Travel to the Spire of the Stars.
Reach the top of the spire.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Spire of the Stars
records.summary: Step from the spire into the Abyss and look into the rift waiting there.

steps.text: Move from the top of the Spire of the Stars into the Abyss.
Investigate the rift on that side.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Obsession and Madness
records.summary: Find who opened the rift, then hear Grundir out.

steps.text: Search out who caused the rift.
Speak with Grundir about what you found.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Casted Shadow
records.summary: Leave the spire and the institute behind and return to Howling Hill.

steps.text: Leave the Spire of the Stars and Scholastone.
Return to Howling Hill.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Trial of the Winds
records.summary: Mandatory chapter 2 quest at the first Ancient Obelisk; completing it unlocks gliding.
records.body: This is the gliding trial reached during Chapter 2: Golden Greed, at the first Ancient Obelisk; it is not a listed main-story quest.

prerequisites.text: Reach chapter 2 of the main story

steps.text: Travel to the first Ancient Obelisk the quest marks.
Complete the trial at the obelisk.

records.name: Early Encounter
records.summary: Short side quest near the Timberturner Wainwright, north of the Nas River, that unlocks the 1,000-slot Collectibles Chest.

steps.text: Find the Timberturner Wainwright north of the Nas River in Hernand and speak to the quest giver.
Complete the errand; the Collectibles Chest opens afterwards for quest items, lore notes and learned recipe books.
